annotations.title: Search documentation available to my account

description: Search documentation using the connected SuperCatch account's permissions. Returns a permission-filtered table of contents or cited sections, including staff guides only for current staff roles. Requires OAuth docs:read consent; signing in alone does not grant access to staff documentation.

documentId.description: Document id from the table of contents.

query.description: Search words; omit for the table of contents.
